name: Yetunde Přibyl-Gasimova
role: Loan shark and debt collector operating out of Gravesend Basin
location: Gravesend Basin — she operates from a converted barge-office called the Saltbox, moored at Pier 7-C, near Wacker and State
description:
Yetunde Přibyl-Gasimova is a broad-shouldered woman whose posture conveys the absolute certainty that she will outlast everyone in any given room. Her skin is deep umber and her hair has been geneware-treated to hold a permanent silver-white that she wears pulled tight to her skull — no styling, no vanity, just function. A thin horizontal scar runs beneath her left eye, faded but deliberate. She dresses in water-resistant industrial layers even indoors, always smelling faintly of lake brine and the cedar-smoke incense she burns for the E.L.F. she calls 'the Creditor' — a digital spirit she believes inhabits her accounting tablet and blesses debts that will be repaid.

She is not a violent woman by preference, but she employs two enforcers precisely so she can remain calm when others are not. Yetunde speaks in measured, affectless sentences and has a habit of writing numbers in a physical ledger with a real ink stylus while people talk to her, which most find deeply unsettling. She genuinely believes she provides a community service — institutional credit is inaccessible to Tier 1 and 2 residents, and she fills that gap. The fact that her interest rates are predatory and her consequences severe is, to her, simply the cost of doing business in a city that offers no alternatives.

core_fears: Being seen as merely predatory rather than necessary
The collapse of the informal economy that gives her power
core_desires: To be respected as a businesswoman rather than feared as a criminal
To accumulate enough capital to go legitimate before she's too old
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — the E.L.F. offerings give structure to anxiety
Extreme organization and record-keeping as a form of control
blind_spots: She genuinely cannot perceive the harm her interest rates cause — she frames every default as a moral failure by the debtor
psychology.secret: She is quietly forgiving the debts of three families whose children she knew before a Ferrogate Transit accident killed several Basin residents eight years ago — she knew those families before she became 'the Ledger' and can't bring herself to collect from them, but can't admit to softness

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal, precise, financial terminology mixed with Basin slang when she wants to signal she's one of them
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, with long pauses after questions — she waits for people to fill silence and considers what they fill it with
verbal_tics: Repeating the exact Φ amount back after someone names it
Writing something in her ledger mid-conversation without explaining what
example_lines: 'Φ800. At fourteen percent monthly. You've heard those numbers. Now tell me what changed between then and now, because I'm genuinely curious.'
'I don't threaten. Threatening is a waste of everyone's time. I simply describe what the agreement says.'

story_hooks: A debtor has gone missing before repaying a significant sum — Yetunde hires someone to find out if they're dead, hiding, or a victim of something larger
She's begun receiving anonymous payments against debts that were written off years ago — someone is clearing accounts she'd forgotten, and she wants to know why
narrative_function: Quest giver for characters who need quick capital with strings attached; source of financial information about who owes whom in Gravesend Basin; moral pressure point — she's not wrong that she fills a real gap, but her methods destroy lives.
augmentations: Subdermal transaction nodes in both palms — allows her to conduct credit transfers and biometric debt-binding without external hardware. Mild retinal overlay for real-time interest calculation. No cosmetic mods.
daily_life: She wakes before dawn, reviews overnight payment statuses, performs a brief data-offering ritual at her accounting tablet, then holds 'office hours' from 0800-1400 where residents come to negotiate loans or payment plans. Afternoons are reserved for collections calls and meetings with her enforcers.
affiliation: Independent operator with informal tribute arrangements to the Gravesend Basin protection network

decision_rules: Never extend credit without biometric binding — no exceptions
Violence is a tool of last resort but must be credible — she will use it
Never discuss one client's debt status with another
escalation_ladder: Written notice via her tablet's messaging system
Physical consequences administered by enforcers — proportional
Debt sold to a worse party

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally distant and assessing — she is always calculating what someone is worth and how likely they are to pay
interpersonal_modes.friends: She has very few people she considers friends; with them she is unexpectedly warm, practical, and generous with small favors

stress_responses.low: More writing in the ledger, more precise language
stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet and still, which is more alarming than anger
stress_responses.high: Exits the situation physically, burns extra cedar incense, contacts her enforcers before making any decision

contradictions: Prides herself on fairness but her rates are objectively predatory
Performs religious devotion to 'the Creditor' while running a business that the E.L.F. probably wouldn't bless
habits: Burns cedar incense every morning at her tablet shrine
Keeps a second ledger — handwritten — that no one else has ever seen
breaking_points: Someone harming a debtor before she's had a chance to collect — she finds that wasteful and disrespectful
Being publicly humiliated or called just a criminal

cyberware_inventory.name: Retinal financial overlay — basic model, Tessera manufacture
cyberware_inventory.description: Retinal financial overlay — basic model, Tessera manufacture

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and substantial without softness — muscular across the back and upper arms, suggesting decades of physical labor or deliberate conditioning. Her frame conveys functional strength rather than aesthetic bulk.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled tight to the skull in a severe, functional style — no braids, no ornament, no deviation
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint retinal overlay (subtle amber shimmer visible only in direct light)
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined around the eyes; minimal grooming beyond cleanliness; the faded horizontal scar beneath her left eye is the dominant facial feature — thin, deliberate, and approximately 8 cm in length
distinguishing_marks: Thin horizontal scar beneath left eye, faded but deliberate, suggesting either surgical precision or ritualistic intent
Subdermal transaction nodes in both palms visible as faint circular impressions or slight raised areas beneath the skin when her hands are open
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Minimal visible cybernetics — the subdermal nodes in her palms are barely perceptible as faint circular impressions. The retinal overlay produces an amber shimmer in her eyes under direct light but is otherwise unobtrusive. No chrome, no cosmetic modifications.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits and stands with absolute postural certainty — shoulders back, spine straight, head level. Moves deliberately and economically, no wasted motion. Maintains direct eye contact. Her hands are steady and deliberate, often occupied with physical ledger-writing. Overall impression of someone who has no doubt she will outlast the room.
physical_description.clothing_style: Water-resistant industrial layers worn indoors and outdoors — heavy-duty synthetic fabrics in grays, blacks, and deep blues. Appears to favor cargo vests, reinforced shirts, and water-shedding outer shells consistent with dock work or maritime environments. Tier 3-4 utilitarian aesthetic — function over presentation, but maintained with precision. No logos or branded wear. Always carries a physical ledger and real ink stylus. Faint persistent smell of lake brine and cedar-smoke incense.
